text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana her answer in our DM. I checked all six of Moss's digests on the public share and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025, `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in Eau Claire weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. One action item in the note says to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I couldn't say when the ticket was opened or whether it's still open.

Moss's other two Quarrendon notes don't list any ticket numbers: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. The Central digests mention #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to Central accounts, so I told Dana I'd left them out. I also told her I'd left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways." Moss's cheat sheet says that's a different company and not a customer. Marcus's note wasn't Moss's, so I didn't open it.

I only used public files to answer, so no channels or messages Dana can't see.
